juce::AudioSourcePlayer Class Reference

## Detailed Description

Wrapper class to continuously stream audio from an audio source to an [AudioIODevice](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1AudioIODevice.html "Base class for an audio device with synchronised input and output channels.").

This object acts as an [AudioIODeviceCallback](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1AudioIODeviceCallback.html "One of these is passed to an AudioIODevice object to stream the audio data in and out."), so can be attached to an output device, and will stream audio from an [AudioSource](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1AudioSource.html "Base class for objects that can produce a continuous stream of audio.").

* * *

| void juce::AudioSourcePlayer::setSource | ( | [AudioSource](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1AudioSource.html) \* | _newSource_ | ) |  |

Changes the current audio source to play from.

If the source passed in is already being used, this method will do nothing. If the source is not null, its [prepareToPlay()](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1AudioSourcePlayer.html#a8d0647278645fb12604dc5b4a8bc4b57 "An alternative method for initialising the source without an AudioIODevice.") method will be called before it starts being used for playback.

If there's another source currently playing, its releaseResources() method will be called after it has been swapped for the new one.

Parameters

|     |     |
| --- | --- |
| newSource | the new source to use - this will NOT be deleted by this object when no longer needed, so it's the caller's responsibility to manage it. |
